title: The Trojan Horse Strikes Back
about: The family's returning Christmas horse becomes a Trojan horse with an unexpected army inside.
description: The family's traveling Christmas horse had already survived years of increasingly imaginative surprises, but the competition was far from over. When a cousin gave the familiar toy a more imposing body, the next stage of the prank practically wrote itself: a Trojan horse, complete with a miniature force ready to launch its own Christmas invasion. The Trojan Horse Strikes Back turns a running family joke into a mock battle filled with parachuting soldiers, clever payback, and the determination to make this year's gift even more memorable than the last.
